union.name: MITSU Student Union
union.overview: The Student Union of the Faculty of Information Technology at MUST is the official representative body of students. It works to enhance student life by organizing academic, cultural, social, sports, artistic, and community activities while strengthening communication between students and the faculty administration. The Union aims to create an engaging, supportive, and inspiring university environment for every student.
union.vision: To build an innovative, collaborative, and inclusive student community that empowers every student to achieve academic excellence, personal growth, leadership, and social responsibility.
union.mission: To represent students effectively, organize meaningful activities, support student initiatives, foster leadership skills, and connect students with university opportunities through transparent communication and teamwork.

about.heading: About MITSU
about.introduction: MITSU is the official digital platform developed by the Student Union of the Faculty of Information Technology at Misr University for Science and Technology (MUST). The platform is designed to become the primary digital gateway for freshmen, providing one trusted place where students can begin their university journey. MITSU is intended to remain useful for future Student Union boards through a scalable and maintainable architecture.
about.vision: Create a unified digital experience that allows every freshman to begin university life with confidence, clarity, and immediate access to official university resources.
about.mission: Simplify communication between freshmen, the Student Union, and official university systems through one reliable, modern, mobile-first platform.
about.goalsSubheading: Eight core values guide every decision we make.
about.motto: One Platform. One Community. One Trusted Start.

studentFirst.title: Student First
studentFirst.description: Every decision must improve the student experience. If a feature does not help students, it should not exist.

official.title: Official
official.description: All information must originate from official university or Student Union sources. No unofficial policies should appear.

simple.title: Simple
simple.description: Freshmen should never feel overwhelmed. Complex university processes are explained through simple language and step-by-step guidance.

accessible.title: Accessible
accessible.description: The platform must be usable by everyone, on mobile, tablet, and desktop, in both Arabic and English.

reliable.title: Reliable
reliable.description: Students must trust the information presented. Broken links, outdated announcements, and unofficial information are unacceptable.

scalable.title: Scalable
scalable.description: The platform is built to keep growing, so future Student Union boards can add new sections without redesigning the system.

maintainable.title: Maintainable
maintainable.description: The project stays understandable to developers who didn't originally build it, with readable code and documentation.

professional.title: Professional
professional.description: The platform represents the Student Union. Every screen reflects professionalism, clarity, and quality.
